title: SG independently feasible saved native witness, reference-only v1
semantic_requirements: Hash-bind this schema, the completed audit REPORT, ARTIFACT_SHA256, and full OFFERED_NATIVE_ROWS ledger before import.
Bind exact dataset/model schema, workload, full query caps and fixed horizon; query ID alone never permits a join.
Re-open hash-bound command, result when present, native manifest and pass. Verify freeze/build/runtime/source/binary and descriptor repetition/warmup.
Locate source witness by native_record_index, native_stage, source_branch and source_point_index. Verify canonical source journey digest.

Verify original initial walking timestamps are anchored at source_ready with exact model durations before transformation. Apply only declared transform to initial contiguous walk prefix. Keep ride, middle-walk and egress events fixed. Check transformed digest.
Independently reconstruct every transformed leg using Checker under the exact recipient base query. Do not import source-ready metrics unchanged.
Occurrence locators must be unique. Duplicate journey identities across distinct raw/final/point occurrences are valid lineage and merge without losing provenance.
This is feasible-reference enrichment, never a scalar-result record, completed serving row, or a global/profile/TAD frontier proof.
All offered native rows, including missing/empty/unsupported/preparation-failed outputs, remain explicit in the source ledger.
